title: access_token member holding a placeholder, a reference, a masked display or no value
summary: A token response whose access_token member holds an angle-bracket placeholder, a template reference, an environment reference or a masked display, and a response with no access_token member.
rationale: A placeholder, a template reference and an environment reference stand in for a value kept elsewhere, a masked display has no recoverable value, and a response with only token_type holds no token. Protecting any of these would redact text a reader needs to understand how a response or configuration is shaped.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#238, Group E). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: the texts here are placeholders, references, masked text or a response with no token, not credential values. That a placeholder, reference or mask is not a value is a project decision, not a Dropbox statement.

sources.supports: The example response labelled legacy long-lived access token has access_token, token_type (bearer), account_id and uid members and no expires_in or refresh_token member; the page states it as an example and gives no format rule for the access_token value.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
